content: Kodi 21 Omega / 22 Piers add-on breakage. Kodi's stated deprecation policy is that something deprecated in version N keeps working in N and is removed in N+1, but in practice ListItem.setInfo and its siblings are still present in master (Kodi 22) three releases after being deprecated in v20. 21.x point releases (21.1/21.2/21.3) are explicitly non-breaking for add-ons. Kodi 22 Piers is in alpha/nightly and is reported to break add-ons, skins and helper libraries. Confirmed removal that already bit Kodi-19-era code: xbmc.translatePath was deprecated in Matrix (PR 18345 moved it to xbmcvfs) and REMOVED in Nexus (PR 19301) - code calling xbmc.translatePath raises AttributeError on Kodi 20+. Kodi 20 also introduced a sys.path ordering regression (xbmc/xbmc issue 22985): Kodi 19 ordered addon -> dependencies -> system python -> site-packages, Kodi 20 reversed it to system python -> site-packages -> addon -> dependencies, so an add-on bundling its own copy of a library (requests, urllib3) could silently load the system copy instead. Marked Resolution: Fixed via PR 23244, but installs on the affected 20.x builds still exhibit it.
